EmailTemplate.description: Default template for the Registrar - Graduation Missing Reqs Letter
EmailTemplate.name: Case Management Registrar Graduation Missing Reqs Letter
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
We have received your application for graduation. Unfortunately, we are unable to complete the application process because you are not meeting requirements for your degree in the semester you indicated on your application form.
The problems we noted are marked below. Only the bold statements apply to you.
Total hours required for the degree are not completed and you have not indicated an adequate number of potential transfer credits. The university requires a minimum of 120 total credit hours.
Total upper division hours required for the degree are not completed and you have not indicated an adequate number of potential upper division transfer credits. The university requires a minimum of 45 credit hours (51 for business degrees) in upper division classes.
Other:
Contact your academic advisor. Please notify us of any corrections or if you are transferring in hours from another institution at 480-965-3256 by << >>. It is imperative that you contact us prior to this date to avoid your immediate withdrawal from the graduation process. If you will not meet requirements in the semester you requested, you will need to refile for graduation for the semester in which you will complete requirements. Please note that if you refile for graduation, you will not be required to pay the graduation fee again.
Sincerely, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Graduation University Registrar Services Arizona State University Phone: (480) 965-3256 www.asu.edu
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
